latestVersion.changelog:
book-id 1.0.0

- Initial release: Skill for cataloging books via photo or text trigger.
- Enforces 32-property markdown schema; all fields required, blanks allowed—none may be omitted.
- Strict workflow: cover reading step, explicit title/author confirmation, web search for data, duplicate check, and photo/file storage.
- Standardizes output filenames and frontmatter/body templates; detailed formatting and content rules.
- Covers must use only OpenLibrary URLs; never allow values with brackets, accents, or "Unknown".
- Checks and prompts included to minimize cataloging errors and ensure data integrity.
